I am learning bioinformatics from first principles.

This series is my attempt to understand not only **how to use bioinformatics tools**, but also the mathematics, algorithms, and biological assumptions behind them.

I write these notes primarily to consolidate my own understanding. Hopefully, they may also be useful to others learning bioinformatics.
